name: @chai-ui/svelte
description: Chai UI Svelte components — smart, drop-in UI for AI apps: Composer, Media Analyzer, Result Card, Edit Card, and the useComposer hook.
author: kazarazat

scripts.build: rimraf dist && svelte-package -i src -o dist && node ../shared/build-css.mjs
scripts.test: vitest run && vitest run --config vitest.ssr.config.ts && vitest run --config vitest.browser.config.ts
scripts.test:coverage: vitest run --coverage --coverage.reporter=lcov --coverage.reporter=text-summary --coverage.include=src/** --coverage.reportsDirectory=coverage/unit && vitest run --config vitest.ssr.config.ts --coverage --coverage.reporter=lcov --coverage.reporter=text-summary --coverage.include=src/** --coverage.reportsDirectory=coverage/ssr && vitest run --config vitest.browser.config.ts --coverage --coverage.reporter=lcov --coverage.reporter=text-summary --coverage.include=src/** --coverage.reportsDirectory=coverage/browser
